attributes.name: gradient
attributes.description: With variant=gradient: "from to [deg]", palette colors or CSS colors ("teal blue 90"). Default: the --ray-gradient-* tokens.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color (blue, red…) or any CSS color. Default: the primary color.

attributes.name: type

attributes.name: disabled

attributes.name: loading

attributes.name: full-width

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a link instead of a button.

tags.name: ray-button-group
tags.description: role=group; give it a label. The corners come from the --ray-group-radius-* custom properties, which your own components can read too.

attributes.name: full-width
attributes.description: Fills its container; the children share the width.

tags.name: ray-icon-button
tags.description: Same properties as ray-button; variant defaults to subtle.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip (required: the button has no text).

attributes.name: gradient

attributes.name: full-width

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a link instead of a button.

tags.name: ray-toggle
tags.description: Click, Enter or Space flips pressed and fires change. In a form it is submitted like a checkbox: value (default "on") under name while pressed; reset restores the initial pressed attribute.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Look of "on": subtle (tint), outline (colored border + tint), light (muted → tint), filled (surface → solid color), raised (a key that latches down, lit). ray-button's default, transparent and gradient are left out: no distinct on state, or only a color change.

attributes.name: square
attributes.description: Square, for an icon alone (give it a label).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip, for icon-only toggles.

attributes.name: gradient
attributes.description: With variant=gradient: "from to [deg]", palette colors or CSS colors ("teal blue 90"). Default: the --ray-gradient-* tokens.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color (blue, red…) or any CSS color. Default: the primary color.

attributes.name: full-width
attributes.description: Takes the whole width of its container.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a link instead of a button.

tags.name: ray-toggle-group
tags.description: Each toggle's value (else its text) is its key. variant, color, size, radius and square reach the toggles that do not set their own. One tab stop (the selected toggle); arrows, Home and End move; Space/Enter flips.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: single: choosing one turns the others off; multiple: each toggle is independent.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected key (single) or keys (multiple: an array, or a comma-separated attribute).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name: the value (multiple: one entry per key).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Needs a value; with single the selected toggle cannot be turned off.

attributes.name: spaced
attributes.description: Toggles apart, each with its own corners (default: joined).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Color of the toggles' on state.

attributes.name: full-width
attributes.description: Fills its container; the children share the width.

tags.name: ray-checkbox
tags.description: A checkbox with label, description and error. Submits value when checked.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed state; cleared on the next user change.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label text (or put the label in the content).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Checked look: filled box, or colored border and mark.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color for the checked state.

tags.name: ray-checkbox-group
tags.description: The group is the form control: one entry per checked value under name (like checkboxes sharing a name); the checkboxes inside lose their own name. It stops their change events and fires its own. role="group" named by its label.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: At least one must be checked.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: At most this many: the others are disabled once reached; the label shows the count.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size of the checkboxes that set none.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Color of the checkboxes that set none.

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the checkboxes or after them.

tags.name: ray-color-picker
tags.description: Keyboard: arrows move the area's thumb (saturation, brightness) or a slider's; Shift for 10× steps; Home/End on the sliders. The alpha slider shows when format has alpha.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The color, written in format. Any color is accepted and rewritten in format. The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How value is written: hex, hexa, rgb, rgba, hsl or hsla. Formats ending in a show the opacity slider.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: Preset colors below the picker: an array, or a comma-separated list in the attribute (commas inside rgb()/hsl() are kept).

attributes.name: swatches-only
attributes.description: Only the swatches: no area nor sliders.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Width of the picker and size of its thumbs.

attributes.name: full-width
attributes.description: Takes the width of its container.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the whole picker.

tags.name: ray-color-input
tags.description: Type any CSS color (it becomes the value as soon as it is valid; invalid text goes back to the value on blur), or open the picker with a click or ArrowDown. The eyedropper shows only where the browser has the EyeDropper API.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The color, written in format. The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How value is written: hex, hexa, rgb, rgba, hsl or hsla.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: Preset colors in the dropdown (an array, or a comma-separated list).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error message; marks the field invalid.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl or a CSS length.

tags.name: ray-combobox
tags.description: The WAI-ARIA combobox pattern (a text field with a listbox popup; the active option is aria-activedescendant). Arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes (then clears with clearable), Backspace in an empty field removes the last chip. The form gets one entry per value.

attributes.name: creatable
attributes.description: What was typed can be added when no option matches it ("+ Create …"); fires ray-create.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: A button that clears the value.

attributes.name: max-values
attributes.description: With multiple: at most this many.

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: At most this many options shown (large lists: keep typing).

tags.name: ray-date-picker
tags.description: Values are ISO dates ("2026-10-06"), submitted as such. ArrowDown on the field opens the calendar; Escape closes it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The chosen date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" ("" for none). The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable date (ISO). Earlier days are disabled; an earlier value is invalid (rangeUnderflow).

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Shown while no date is chosen.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How the date is displayed (Intl dateStyle).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale for names and formats. Default: the nearest lang attribute, else the browser's.

attributes.name: first-day
attributes.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Default: the locale's.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows a button that clears the date.

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

tags.name: ray-calendar
tags.description: WAI-ARIA grid: arrows move by day and week, Home/End to the week's ends, PageUp/PageDown by month (with Shift, by year), Enter/Space select.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale for month and weekday names. Default: the nearest lang attribute, else the browser's.

attributes.name: first-day
attributes.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Default: the locale's.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Day cell size and font size.

tags.name: ray-file-upload
tags.description: A drag that can only be refused turns the zone red before the drop; refused files fire ray-reject and are explained under the zone. Without multiple a new file replaces the current one. Uploading is the app's: attachmentFor(file) gives the row whose progress/status/error to set.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name: every file is submitted under it.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text (replaces the explanation of refused files).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form needs at least one file.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Several files (else one, replaced by the next).

attributes.name: max-size
attributes.description: Largest file: bytes or a size like "10 MB", "512 KB".

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description: With multiple: the most files kept.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Small text in the zone. Default: from accept, max-size and max-files ("PNG or PDF · up to 10 MB each · max. 5 files").

attributes.name: drop-label
attributes.description: Title of the zone, before "or browse".

attributes.name: browse-label
attributes.description: The link-styled word (the button text in compact).

attributes.name: active-label
attributes.description: Title while files are dragged over it.

attributes.name: tap-label
attributes.description: Title on touch screens (no hover), where dragging files is rare.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: default: a tall centered zone; compact: one row with a Browse button.

attributes.name: list
attributes.description: How chosen files show: full-width rows, thumbnail cards, or not at all (render your own on change).

attributes.name: native
attributes.description: With a native host (ray-elements/core/raylang.js in a std/ui window), browsing opens the system dialog and gives paths (see `paths`); drop and paste still give Files.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Accent of hover, drag and the browse link (default: primary).

tags.name: ray-input
tags.description: Also forwards placeholder, autocomplete, inputmode, pattern, min, max, step, minlength, maxlength, spellcheck, autocapitalize, enterkeyhint and list to the inner input.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value. The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text; marks the field invalid (display only — does not block submit).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Required for form submission; shows an asterisk.

attributes.name: enterkeyhint
attributes.description: Label of the Enter key on virtual keyboards.

tags.name: ray-number-input
tags.description: Arrow Up/Down step (Shift: ×10), Page Up/Down ×10, Home/End go to min/max. The value is a number (undefined when empty); the form gets its plain digits; min and max are checked (rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow).

attributes.name: thousands-separator
attributes.description: Groups thousands in the shown text (",", ".", " ").

attributes.name: decimal-separator
attributes.description: The decimal mark shown and typed ("," in many locales).

attributes.name: clamp
attributes.description: When out-of-range input is clamped: on blur, while typing, or never (then it is invalid).

attributes.name: hide-controls
attributes.description: No + and − buttons (the keys still step).

tags.name: ray-password-input
tags.description: autocomplete defaults to current-password: use new-password on sign-up and change forms. The toggle keeps the focus and the caret in the field.

attributes.name: visible

attributes.name: show-label

attributes.name: hide-label

attributes.name: enterkeyhint
attributes.description: Label of the Enter key on virtual keyboards.

tags.name: ray-path-input

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: What the dialog chooses: an existing file, a folder, or a file to save (the current name is suggested).

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: File types the dialog offers, as in <input type=file>: ".json,.toml", "image/*" (ignored for folders).

attributes.name: dialog-title
attributes.description: Title of the system dialog (default: the label).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value. The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text; marks the field invalid (display only — does not block submit).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Required for form submission; shows an asterisk.

attributes.name: enterkeyhint
attributes.description: Label of the Enter key on virtual keyboards.

tags.name: ray-radio-group
tags.description: Arrow keys move the selection, Tab enters and leaves the group.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the checked radio. Initial: the value attribute, or a radio with the checked attribute.

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: A choice is needed to submit.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Checked look of every radio: filled circle, or colored ring and dot.

tags.name: ray-radio

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value given to the group when chosen.

tags.name: ray-search
tags.description: Escape clears it (when it has text); Enter fires ray-search at once. JS: clear(), focus().

attributes.name: shortcut
attributes.description: Keyboard shortcut that focuses it ("mod+k", "/"; mod = ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere). Shown as a hint while empty.

attributes.name: debounce
attributes.description: Milliseconds of quiet typing before ray-search fires (0: on every keystroke).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label (also the accessible name). Without it, use aria-label.

tags.name: ray-segmented-control

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected value (default: the first enabled option).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Indicator color (default: a raised neutral segment).

tags.name: ray-select
tags.description: A select with its own dropdown (keyboard, typeahead, groups); options from child <option> elements or the data property. Form-associated.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Shown while nothing is selected (with required, blocks submit).

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

tags.name: ray-slider
tags.description: A native range input (keyboard, touch and screen readers as usual) with label, value display and marks. Form-associated.

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

attributes.name: show-value
attributes.description: Shows the value next to the label.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Appended to the shown value and its spoken text (%, px, ms…).

tags.name: ray-switch

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed state; cleared on the next user change.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Checked look: filled box, or colored border and mark.

tags.name: ray-textarea
tags.description: Also forwards placeholder, autocomplete, minlength, maxlength, spellcheck and wrap. Initial value: the value attribute or the element's text.

attributes.name: max-rows
attributes.description: With autosize: stop growing and scroll after this many rows.

attributes.name: description-position
attributes.description: The description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).

tags.name: ray-bottom-nav
tags.description: With href items it marks the link to this page (aria-current="page"); without, it is a control (value, change). Clear of the home indicator (safe-area inset). In a ray-app-shell, put it in the bottom slot.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current destination (an item's value, else its href, else its label).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Which labels show (the others stay for assistive technology).

attributes.name: indicator
attributes.description: How the current destination is marked besides its color.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color for the current item and the action (default: primary).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: default: a bar across the bottom; floating: a rounded bar off the edges.

attributes.name: hide-on-scroll
attributes.description: Slides away while the content scrolls down, back on the way up.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Pinned to the bottom of the window (outside a shell).

attributes.name: scroll-target
attributes.description: A selector of the element whose scrolling it follows (default: its shell's, else the window).

tags.name: ray-bottom-nav-item
tags.description: A link with href, else a button. The badge is read with the label ("Messages, 3").

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Its value (default: its href, else its label).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: An icon of the registry (or put one in the icon slot).

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: A count or a short text on the icon.

attributes.name: dot
attributes.description: A dot on the icon (something new).

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Set by the bar: the current destination.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: A raised round button ("New"): it fires ray-select on the bar, it is not a destination.

tags.name: ray-breadcrumbs
tags.description: A <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> around a list. The last crumb is the current page (aria-current="page") unless one says current.

attributes.name: max-items
attributes.description: Longer paths show the first crumb, "…" (a button that expands them) and the last max-items − 1.

tags.name: ray-breadcrumb
tags.description: A link with href (text without, or when current).

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: This crumb is the current page (default: the last).

tags.name: ray-nav-link
tags.description: A link with href (aria-current=page when active), or a button that toggles its nested links.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes it a link (ignored when it has nested links).

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: Only the icon (left section), centered; the label becomes its accessible name and tooltip. A collapsed ray-sidebar sets it.

tags.name: ray-pagination
tags.description: JS: setPage(n), next(), previous(), first(), last(); page (clamped value).

attributes.name: siblings
attributes.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

attributes.name: boundaries
attributes.description: Pages always shown at the start and the end.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Color of the current page: a palette color or any CSS color. Default: the primary color.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

tags.name: ray-sidebar
tags.description: Put ray-sidebar-group + ray-nav-link (with an icon in slot=left) inside. Collapsed, nav links show only their icon (the label becomes the tooltip) and the host has the collapsed attribute, so your own header/footer content can hide with CSS (ray-sidebar[collapsed] .brand-name { display: none }).

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Wide screens: an icon rail instead of the full panel.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Narrow screens: the drawer is shown (modal, focus trapped; Escape, backdrop click or a followed link close it).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: A panel against the edge, or a floating card with a margin.

attributes.name: collapsed-width
attributes.description: Width of the icon rail. Default 3.5rem.

attributes.name: breakpoint
attributes.description: At this viewport width and below, it becomes a drawer.

tags.name: ray-sidebar-group
tags.description: A titled section of nav links; the title fades out (keeping its height) when the sidebar collapses.

tags.name: ray-stepper
tags.description: The steps are a labelled list; the active one has aria-current="step" and each reads "Step 2 of 4: Shipping, completed". Only the active step's content shows; past the last step, the completed slot.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Index of the active step (steps.length: completed).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Steps in a row above the content, or in a column beside it.

attributes.name: icon-position
attributes.description: Label beside the number, or under it (narrow screens, many steps).

attributes.name: allow-step-select
attributes.description: Completed steps are buttons that go back to them.

attributes.name: linear
attributes.description: With allow-step-select off, false lets the user jump to any step.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color for active and completed steps (default: primary).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the list of steps.

tags.name: ray-step
tags.description: A step: its header is drawn by the stepper, its content shows while it is active.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: An icon instead of the number.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: A spinner instead of the number.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: An error message: red step, the message as its description.

tags.name: ray-tabs
tags.description: Tabs and panels (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern): arrows, Home/End, automatic or manual activation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the active tab (default: the first enabled one).

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: manual: arrows move focus, Enter/Space activates.

tags.name: ray-tab
tags.description: Tabs and panels (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern): arrows, Home/End, automatic or manual activation.

tags.name: ray-tab-panel
tags.description: Tabs and panels (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern): arrows, Home/End, automatic or manual activation.

tags.name: ray-command-palette

attributes.name: hotkey
attributes.description: Toggle shortcut (mod = ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere); empty to disable.

attributes.name: hide-hint
attributes.description: No keyboard hint at the bottom.

attributes.name: native-menus

attributes.name: overlay-blur

tags.name: ray-dialog

JS: show(), close(returnValue), confirmDialog({ label, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, color, native }) -> Promise<boolean>; with a native host (ray-elements/core/raylang.js in a std/ui window) it asks with the system dialog unless native is false.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A line under the title (the dialog's accessible description).

attributes.name: size

attributes.name: height

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: lg.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Escape and backdrop clicks do not close it (the × still does; hide it with hide-close). To allow only one of them, cancel ray-request-close by its source.

attributes.name: hide-close
attributes.description: No close button in the header.

attributes.name: overlay-blur
attributes.description: Blur of the page behind: px ("8"), a CSS length or "none". Default: --ray-overlay-blur ([overlay] blur in tokens.toml).

tags.name: ray-drawer

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A line under the title (the drawer's accessible description).

attributes.name: size

attributes.name: modeless

attributes.name: floating
attributes.description: Detached from the edge, with rounded corners.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Escape and backdrop clicks do not close it.

attributes.name: hide-close
attributes.description: No close button in the header.

attributes.name: overlay-blur
attributes.description: Blur of the page behind: px ("8"), a CSS length or "none". Default: --ray-overlay-blur ([overlay] blur in tokens.toml).

tags.name: ray-menu-item

attributes.name: color

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color. Default: inverted foreground/background.

tags.name: ray-accordion
tags.description: Collapsible sections (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern); one open at a time, or several with multiple.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Open item's value; with multiple, an array (attribute: comma-separated).

tags.name: ray-accordion-item
tags.description: Collapsible sections (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern); one open at a time, or several with multiple.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Identifies the item in the accordion's value.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A secondary line under the label, in the header.

tags.name: ray-attachment
tags.description: Assign a File to `file` to fill name, size, type and an image thumbnail. Removing it (× button) fires a cancelable ray-remove and then removes the element.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: File name (ellipsized; full name in the tooltip).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size in bytes, shown as "12 KB", "3.4 MB".

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: MIME type: picks the icon (image or file) and, with the name, the extension badge.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Thumbnail URL for images (falls back to the icon if it fails to load).

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the name a download link.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: Upload progress 0–100: a thin bar and "Uploading… 45%". Unset: done.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Explicit state. Default: "uploading" while progress is set, else "done".

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error text shown with status="error" (default "Upload failed").

attributes.name: remove-label
attributes.description: Accessible label of the remove button; {name} is replaced by the file name.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: row: a compact chip; card: the thumbnail on top.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dimmed, not removable, the name is not a link.

tags.name: ray-attachments
tags.description: A wrapping row of ray-attachment elements.

tags.name: ray-avatar
tags.description: An image, the initials of a name, or a placeholder icon.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL; falls back to initials if it fails to load.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Person or entity name; its initials are shown without an image.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color.

tags.name: ray-badge
tags.description: A short status label.

attributes.name: gradient
attributes.description: With variant=gradient: "from to [deg]", palette colors or CSS colors ("teal blue 90"). Default: the --ray-gradient-* tokens.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color.

attributes.name: normal-case
attributes.description: Keeps the text as written instead of uppercase.

tags.name: ray-blockquote
tags.description: Paragraphs in it are spaced and the last one has no bottom margin. The attribution is text (cite) or rich content (slot="cite": an avatar, a name, a role).

attributes.name: cite
attributes.description: Who said it, shown below the quote ("— Grace Hopper").

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: URL of the source: the inner blockquote's cite attribute.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color, for the edge, the mark and the tint. Default: the primary.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: light: tinted background; outline: border and edge only; filled: solid color (a pull quote).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Registry icon of the mark, or none. The icon slot replaces it.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Text size (lg for a pull quote).

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Inner spacing: xs…xl (the spacing scale), px as a number, or a CSS length. Default: md.

attributes.name: hide-edge
attributes.description: No colored edge on the start side (the tint, border and mark stay).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: md.

tags.name: ray-carousel
tags.description: Any child is a slide. With several slides in view, positions are the snap points the viewport can reach. ArrowLeft/Right (Up/Down when vertical), Home and End move it.

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Current position (0-based). Setting it scrolls there.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the carousel region.

attributes.name: slide-size
attributes.description: Size of each slide along the scroll axis ("100%" by default; "50%", "18rem"…).

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Where a slide snaps in the viewport.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Scroll axis (vertical needs a height; 20rem by default).

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: next() on the last position goes to the first, prev() on the first to the last.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Milliseconds between automatic moves (0: off). Pauses on hover, focus and when the page is hidden; starts paused with reduced motion. Shows a pause/play button.

tags.name: ray-code
tags.description: The code comes from the code property, a <script type="text/plain"> child (raw text: anything but a closing script tag), a <template> child (parsed as HTML: the easiest for markup, but a < that is not a tag, as in Promise<void>, breaks it), or the element's text; common indentation and blank edges are removed. Built-in languages: js/ts (jsx, tsx), json, html/xml/svg/vue, css, shell, ray and diff; others show as plain text. Library classes painted with the tokens: Prism's .token.*, highlight.js's .hljs-*, and Shiki's css-variables theme.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language: js, ts, jsx, tsx, json, html, xml, svg, vue, css, sh, ray, diff… (also shown in the header). Not lang: that is the human language of the text.

attributes.name: filename
attributes.description: A file name or title in the header; also the scroll region's accessible name.

attributes.name: line-numbers
attributes.description: Numbers each line (not copied, not selectable).

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Height before it scrolls: px as a number, or a CSS length. A taller block gets a "Show all N lines" button.

attributes.name: hide-header
attributes.description: No header bar (the copy button floats in the corner).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: md.

attributes.name: copy-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the copy button.

tags.name: ray-icon
tags.description: setIcons({ name: '<svg…>' }) replaces or adds icons (SVG markup or an SVGElement, drawn with currentColor); iconNames() lists them. Sizes follow the font unless size; --ray-icon-size and --ray-icon-stroke tune the whole system.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: xs…xl or any CSS length. Default: 1em.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative (hidden from screen readers).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color. Default: the text color.

tags.name: ray-indicator
tags.description: Wraps its content as tight as it is (fit-content). The label is part of the element's text for assistive technology; a dot has none: describe it on the content (aria-label="Grace, online").

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text in the indicator (a word or a count). Empty: a dot.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Which point of the content's box it sits on.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Moves it inward from that point: px as a number, or a CSS length. Use it on round content (an avatar), so it sits on the curve.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color. Default: the primary.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Diameter of the dot (and minimum height of a label): px as a number, or a CSS length. Default: 10px.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: round.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: A numeric label above it shows as max+ (99+).

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: inline-block, to sit within a line of text.

attributes.name: with-border
attributes.description: A ring in the background color, to separate it from the content.

attributes.name: processing
attributes.description: A pulse around it (live, recording, syncing).

tags.name: ray-kbd
tags.description: A keyboard key: a raised keycap, or a flat chip (filled or outline) for hints in menus and buttons.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: default: raised keycap; filled: flat muted chip; outline: flat with a border.

tags.name: ray-stat
tags.description: A metric tile: label, value, change against a previous period, note.

attributes.name: diff
attributes.description: Change (positive is shown as good, in green; see inverse).

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A line under the value (compared to…).

attributes.name: inverse
attributes.description: Lower is better (errors, latency): negative diffs are green.

tags.name: ray-table
tags.description: Cells are text (render may return a DOM node; strings are never parsed as HTML). The scroll height comes from --ray-table-max-height.

attributes.name: selectable
attributes.description: A checkbox per row and a select-all checkbox.

attributes.name: manual-sort
attributes.description: Do not sort here: listen to ray-sort and pass sorted data.

attributes.name: clickable-rows
attributes.description: Rows are focusable and fire ray-row-click (Enter too; arrows move between rows).

attributes.name: sticky-header
attributes.description: The header stays visible while scrolling (with --ray-table-max-height).

attributes.name: empty-label
attributes.description: Text without rows (or put a ray-empty-state in slot=empty).

tags.name: ray-timeline
tags.description: A list (role="list") of ray-timeline-item.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Index of the last reached item (-1: none).

attributes.name: bullet-size
attributes.description: Bullet size: px as a number or a CSS length (default 20px).

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color for what is reached (default: primary).

attributes.name: reverse-active
attributes.description: Counts active from the end (the latest event at the top).

tags.name: ray-timeline-item
tags.description: Events in order along a line (Mantine's Timeline): activity, history, a deploy's stages. Items up to active are reached (filled bullet, colored line); a bullet is a dot, an icon or an avatar.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: An icon of the registry in the bullet.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Its own color (a failed step in red).

attributes.name: line-variant
attributes.description: The line to the next item (dashed: not happened yet).

tags.name: ray-alert
tags.description: Announced as an alert. The icon follows the color (info, circle-check, alert-triangle, circle-x) unless icon or slot=icon.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A registered icon name, or none.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: A close button; closing hides the alert (cancel ray-close to keep it).

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the close button.

tags.name: ray-empty-state
tags.description: What a list, table or pane shows when it is empty: icon, title, text and the action that fills it.

tags.name: ray-notification
tags.description: notify({ id, title, message, color, icon, loading, autoClose (ms, default 4000; false = stays), closable, withBorder, onClose }) returns its id. A color adds a status icon in that color: green/teal a check, red/pink an error, yellow/orange a warning, others info. The status icon and the loader are 1.5rem with a 1.5 stroke; set --ray-notification-icon-size and --ray-notification-icon-stroke to change them.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Status color: tints the status icon (and a slotted icon's circle).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Status icon from the registry (default: from the color); "none" for no icon.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows a spinner (notify() does not auto-close it).

attributes.name: action-label
attributes.description: Text of an action button (e.g. "Undo"); pressing it fires ray-action.

tags.name: ray-toaster
tags.description: Created by notify() when missing; add one yourself to choose its position. A stack (newest in front, older ones peeking behind) that spreads into a list on hover or keyboard focus; on touch screens a tap expands it, a tap outside collapses it, and a sideways swipe dismisses a toast. Auto-close pauses while expanded. Full width on phones.

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Maximum kept; the oldest go first.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Toasts shown in the collapsed stack (the rest wait, hidden).

attributes.name: expand
attributes.description: Always expanded: a list instead of a stack.

tags.name: ray-progress
tags.description: A determinate or (without value) indeterminate progress bar, announced as a progressbar.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Progress, from 0 to max. Unset: indeterminate.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The value of a full bar.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color.

attributes.name: show-value
attributes.description: Shows the percentage: inside the bar on lg and xl, beside it on smaller sizes.

tags.name: ray-skeleton
tags.description: aria-busy="true" on the host while loading; the placeholder is aria-hidden.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width (CSS length, a number is px). Default: 100% (a circle: 2.5rem).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of a block or of each line (CSS length, a number is px). Default: 1rem.

attributes.name: circle
attributes.description: A circle (avatar placeholder): its diameter is width, else height.

attributes.name: lines
attributes.description: Number of text lines (the last one is shorter).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, full or a CSS length. Default: sm.

attributes.name: animation
attributes.description: The loading effect (always none with reduced motion).

attributes.name: loaded
attributes.description: Shows the slotted content instead of the placeholder.

tags.name: ray-spinner
tags.description: An indeterminate loading indicator, announced as a status.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: A palette color or any CSS color. Default: the primary color.

tags.name: ray-app-bar
tags.description: It follows the scroller of its ray-app-shell, else scroll-target, else the window; clear of the notch (safe-area inset). The title is plain text: put a heading in the default slot when the page needs one.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: default: the page background; filled: the primary color; transparent: until it elevates.

attributes.name: scroll-behavior
attributes.description: While the content scrolls: elevate (border and shadow), hide (also slides away going down, back going up), none.

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: Sticks to the top of the window (outside a shell).

attributes.name: scroll-target
attributes.description: A selector of the element whose scrolling it follows (default: its shell's, else the window).

tags.name: ray-app-shell
tags.description: The layout follows the shell's own width (a phone-sized frame shows the phone layout). Below breakpoint the navbar and the aside take no room (a ray-sidebar there still opens as its drawer) and the bottom slot shows. It fills the window's height (100dvh) unless sized. In a std/ui full_content window (ray-elements/core/raylang.js) the header becomes the title bar: room for the window buttons, and it drags the window; with layout="alt" or no header, the navbar and main start below it.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: default: the header across the top; alt: the navbar full height, the header beside it.

attributes.name: breakpoint
attributes.description: Width (px, em or rem) below which it takes the phone layout.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Padding of the main area: xs…xl, a number (px) or a CSS length.

tags.name: ray-aspect-ratio
tags.description: A box with a fixed width/height ratio; its image, video or iframe fills it.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.description: How the media fills the box (object-fit).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius: xs…xl, full or a CSS length.

tags.name: ray-card
tags.description: A surface for grouped content, with optional media, header and footer.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: default: card surface; filled: muted surface; outline: border without fill.

tags.name: ray-center
tags.description: It fills its parent's width; give it a height (or a flex or grid parent that stretches it) to center vertically.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: As wide as its content (inline-flex): an icon beside text.

tags.name: ray-container
tags.description: Its content centered, up to a maximum width, with side padding (Mantine's Container): the column of a page.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Maximum width: xs 540px, sm 720px, md 960px, lg 1140px, xl 1320px, or any CSS length.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Side padding: xs…xl, a number (px) or a CSS length.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: No maximum width: the whole width, still padded.

tags.name: ray-grid
tags.description: The widths are the grid's own (container queries: xs 36em, sm 48em, md 62em, lg 75em, xl 88em), so a grid in a narrow column or a phone frame drops to fewer columns. It needs a width from its parent: in a flex row give it one or let it grow. A child spans with data-span="2"…"12" or "full".

attributes.name: cols
attributes.description: Columns: a count, then counts from a width up ("1 sm:2 lg:4").

attributes.name: min-col-width
attributes.description: Instead of cols: as many columns of at least this width as fit ("14rem", 220).

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between cells: xs…xl, a number (px) or a CSS length.

attributes.name: row-gap
attributes.description: Space between rows when it differs from gap.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of the cells in a row.

tags.name: ray-group
tags.description: A flex row on the host: the children are laid out directly, no wrapper.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between children: xs…xl (the space scale), a number (px) or any CSS length.

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: Main-axis distribution: space-between for a title on one side and actions on the other.

attributes.name: nowrap
attributes.description: Keeps the children on one line.

attributes.name: grow
attributes.description: The children share the width equally.

tags.name: ray-scroll-area
tags.description: Give it a size: height, max-height, CSS, or a flex/grid parent. The scrolling box is focusable (keyboard scrolling); name it with label when it holds a region of its own.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Maximum height: it grows with its content up to this, then scrolls.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The scrollbar: auto (when it scrolls), hover (while hovered or scrolling), never (still scrolls).

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: Distance from the end (px) at which ray-reach-end fires.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name: makes the scrolling box a named region.

tags.name: ray-separator
tags.description: A horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labeled (Mantine's Divider).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text in the middle of a horizontal rule.

tags.name: ray-split
tags.description: Divider keys: arrows move it (Shift: faster), Home/End go to min/max, Enter or double click collapse the start pane.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: horizontal: side by side; vertical: stacked.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Initial size of the start pane: px (280) or any CSS length (30%, 20rem).

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Minimum size of the start pane in px.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum size of the start pane in px.

attributes.name: autosave
attributes.description: A key: the size is saved in localStorage and restored.

tags.name: ray-stack
tags.description: A flex column on the host: the children are laid out directly, no wrapper.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between children: xs…xl (the space scale), a number (px) or any CSS length.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Cross-axis alignment: stretch fills the width.

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: Main-axis distribution (with a height to distribute).

tags.name: ray-statusbar
tags.description: The bar at the bottom of an app window: items on the left and on the right; items with action are buttons.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: accent: the primary color (e.g. while debugging).

tags.name: ray-statusbar-item
tags.description: The bar at the bottom of an app window: items on the left and on the right; items with action are buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip (for icon-only or terse items).

tags.name: ray-theme-toggle
tags.description: Icon button that cycles the document theme: system, light, dark.
